basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old anime enthusiast hailing from Portland, Oregon. I recently got into Reddit to connect with other fans of Death Note and JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. Besides my love for anime, I'm a part-time graphic designer with a passion for digital art and character design. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and during weekends. Single and enjoying the freedom to dive into my interests, I often find myself sketching or gaming outside of my work hours.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep interest in anime and manga, primarily self-taught through years of watching series and reading fan theories and analyses. My graphic design skills stem from a combination of formal education and self-led projects.
